query:
SELECT id, firstName, lastName, email, referenceNumber, status
FROM leads
WHERE (
  (LOWER(firstName) LIKE '%sharon%' AND LOWER(lastName) LIKE '%scott%')
  OR (LOWER(firstName) LIKE '%chris%' AND LOWER(lastName) LIKE '%davies%')
  OR (LOWER(firstName) LIKE '%sarah%' AND LOWER(lastName) LIKE '%lauwers%')
  OR (LOWER(firstName) LIKE '%richard%' AND LOWER(lastName) LIKE '%swan%')
  OR (LOWER(lastName) LIKE '%sworn%')
  OR (LOWER(firstName) LIKE '%john%' AND LOWER(lastName) LIKE '%black%')
)
ORDER BY lastName, firstName;
